title: Total US fire department responses per year
notes: NFPA figures show total US fire department responses rising from about 10.8 million in 1980 to about 36.6 million in 2021 -- more than tripling -- driven mostly by medical/EMS calls, which grew from about 5 million to roughly 26.3 million over the same span while fire calls themselves fell. Verified live via web search 2026-11-11.
